title: Environmental Management for Cities and Industrial Estates

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts and approaches to environmental management in urban areas and industrial estates.
Identify and analyze environmental issues specific to urban areas and industrial estates.
Manage solid waste, wastewater, and air pollution in urban areas.
Manage greenhouse gases and organic pollutants in urban areas.
Handle environmental emergencies in urban areas.
Understand the entities involved in environmental management and promote sustainable practices in industrial estates.
Implement energy-efficient and cleaner production practices in industrial estates.
Conduct research and analyze environmental management issues in urban areas and industrial estates.
Work independently and in teams to solve practical environmental management problems.
